comparisons.target_topic: Impact of Export Controls and Supply Chain Restrictions on Business and Competitive Position
comparisons.target_summary: US export controls have restricted NVIDIA's ability to ship specific high-performance products to China and other regions, resulting in no granted licenses for these products and harming the company's competitive position. Additionally, NVIDIA's business depends on consistent supply from overseas partners, particularly in Taiwan, and new restrictions impacting this supply or the ability to transition operations out of restricted regions would negatively affect business results, revenue, and operational flexibility.

comparisons.peer_summary: Government actions and regulations may limit the company's ability to export products to certain customers.

sentences.text: Following these export controls, we transitioned some operations, including certain testing, validation, and supply and distribution operations out of China and Hong Kong.

Any future transitions could be costly and time consuming, and adversely affect our research and development and supply and distribution operations, as well as our revenue, during any such transition period.
◦Government actions and regulations may limit our ability to export our products to certain customers.
